MetaHuman Animator (MHA) is the core Unreal Engine plugin that solves and generates facial animation for MetaHuman characters from video, stereo, depth, and audio performance capture inputs. It owns the end-to-end facial animation pipeline — from MetaHuman Identity calibration and optical flow tracking through landmark processing to Animation Sequence and Level Sequence output — for both offline batch and real-time webcam workflows.

▸ RESPONSIBILITIES
  • Solve facial animation from monocular video, stereo video, depth footage, and audio-driven sources using the MHA processing pipeline (FHyprsenseNodeBase, FDataTree, optical flow, landmark tracking, NNE-backed face contour trackers)
  • Manage MetaHuman Identity (MHI) assets, face part calibration, stereo and camera calibration generation, and Mesh2MetaHuman identity fitting for performance capture sessions
  • Execute real-time facial animation from webcam or live capture devices directly within Unreal Engine via the MHA Live Link source
  • Provide Python scripting API (export_performance.py, audio-driven animation scripts, calibration generation scripts) to automate MH Performance solving and export of Animation Sequences and Level Sequences
  • Process MH Performance assets into Animation Sequences targeting MetaHuman face skeletons (Face_Archetype_Skeleton) for both Unreal Engine and UEFN deployment
  • Handle face part incompatibility resolution, custom FBX export of MHI rigs, animator-friendly curve output, and on-the-fly depth generation within the solver pipeline
